page_title: RBL 2-0 WER | RB Leipzig v Werder Bremen 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The ball is out of play and Werder Bremen manage to earn a corner.

90+6' A sweet pass finds Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Peter Gulacsi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Werder Bremen.
90+5' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
90+5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) steps up to send the ball in.
90+4' The game has come to an end for Yan Diomande. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig).
90+4' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
90+2' The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Assan Ouedraogo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Christoph Baumgartner is replaced by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' A substitution has been made. Senne Lynen is replaced by Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen).
88' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Now RB Leipzig have a corner.
86' A neat pass is well received by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
84' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
82' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

82' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Werder Bremen.
80' 2 - 0 Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
80' RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
78' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
76' Surely that's handball by one of the RB Leipzig players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
75' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
73' Today's match ends for Keke Topp who will be replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen).
73' Marco Grull will be replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
73' Here is a change. Cameron Puertas is going off and Horst Steffen gives the last tactical orders to Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
72' Celebrations are cut short for Werder Bremen as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
72' The Werder Bremen players joy may have been justified, because referee Martin Petersen is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
71' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
71' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.

71' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top left corner, but Peter Gulacsi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) gets a yellow card.
68' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) replaces Conrad Harder.
68' The substitution is prepared. Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonio Nusa.
63' 1 - 0 Goal! Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.
61' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' David Raum (RB Leipzig) prepares to take a corner kick.
57' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
54' The game is interrupted now, Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

52' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
52' The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
51' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Martin Petersen interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Werder Bremen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

48' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
48' The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.

48' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the top of the net from a promising distance, but Peter Gulacsi denies him. The ball goes out for a corner. Werder Bremen can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

45+1' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' RB Leipzig are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
40' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.
40' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig win a corner kick.
39' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
38' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
38' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
36' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' The referee awards a corner and David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.

32' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. The referee blows his whistle, RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
30' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. RB Leipzig are awarded the free kick.
26' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.

21' David Raum (RB Leipzig) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
19' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
16' David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
12' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will deliver the corner kick.
11' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.
9' David Raum (RB Leipzig) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' David Raum (RB Leipzig) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will take a corner kick.

3' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
2' RB Leipzig control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Martin Petersen.
